work_statement: DOCUMENTATION ENGINEER — Implement Braiding Fixes. Read findings from vault-braiding-nesting-scan manifest, then execute consolidation + braiding per 10-vault-maintenance workflow: (1) For duplicates: merge into canonical doc, delete other, redirect wikilinks. (2) For orphans: add wikilink from related doc + update Related footer. (3) For routing errors: correct investigation_label or move to Archive if deprecated. (4) For missing braiding: add breadcrumb + Related section to all docs per 09-vault-architecture pattern.
governance_references: /mnt/d/0LOCAL/CT_VAULT/2026-04-28/08-documentation-governance.md — Canonical doc properties (lock status, version timestamp)
workflow: 1. Read vault-braiding-nesting-scan manifest → extract findings array
2. Prioritize by severity: HIGH consolidations first, MEDIUM braiding, LOW cleanup
3. For each HIGH issue: execute merge per 10-vault-maintenance Section 🧬 (consolidation workflow)
- Merge content into sections + add wikilinks at merge points
- Search all docs for wikilinks to deleted doc → redirect to new location
4. For each MEDIUM/LOW issue: add missing braiding (breadcrumb + Related footer)
5. Validate: re-read 00-DASHBOARD + check wikilinks resolve cleanly
6. Update 00-DASHBOARD status if major consolidations occurred

manifest_decision.vault_health_post_fix: Orphan count reduced from A to B, wikilink density improved

constraints: NEVER delete 07-10 docs (governance layer is locked, updated only via user direction)
NEVER modify 00-DASHBOARD except to update 'Canonical Docs' count + status summary
Preserve all wikilinks (fix broken ones, don't remove)
Add version timestamp + lock status to modified docs per 08-documentation-governance
Create git commit per (consolidation task) + update COC entry
prescan_gating: If vault-braiding-nesting-scan manifest shows <3 issues found, mark as LOW-CONFIDENCE and ask for human review before executing consolidations.
success_criterion: All HIGH findings resolved (consolidations complete), all MEDIUM findings addressed (braiding added), wikilink graph cleans validates (grep -r '\[\[.*\]\]' returns no broken links).
